content: Hey beautiful, I hope you slept well. I couldn't stop thinking about our conversation last night, you really make these lonely nights offshore so much easier.
Good morning! I did, thank you. It's so nice to have someone to talk to again. I've missed this... feeling connected.
You're the light in my days out here. I count down the weeks till I can finally hold you. Sometimes I imagine what it'll be like to cook dinner together in your kitchen.
That sounds wonderful. I keep picturing you walking through my front door. I wish you didn't have to stay away so long.

Honestly, I'd give anything to be there right now. Something came up, though, I'm really stressed about it. My company's payroll is delayed again, and now they're asking me to pay a satellite phone bill so I can keep my post. I'm embarrassed to ask, but I don't have access to my funds at the moment.
Oh no, that sounds awful. Are you okay? Is there anything I can do to help?

It's just a temporary thing. I hate burdening you, but they're threatening to cut my connection if I don't pay today. The company will reimburse me, but all my cards are blocked until I'm back onshore. I trust you, and you're the only one I can turn to right now.
I really want to help you, but I've never sent money overseas before. How does it work? And are you sure they'll pay you back?

I understand your concern, and I promise you'll get every cent back as soon as I'm paid. You're helping me keep my job and our connection. If you have PayPal or can do a wire transfer, I can send you the details. Please, you mean so much to me.
Alright, I can try PayPal. Just send me what I need to do.

Thank you, darling. Here's my PayPal address: jonathan.stevens.ops@gmail.com. The bill is $450, but any amount you can manage helps. Just let me know when you send it so I can confirm with the company.
That's a lot, but I think I can manage. I'm sending it now.
You're truly an angel. I'll remember this forever. Please let me know when it's done, I'll message the company right away, and hopefully, I won't lose my job.
Okay, I just sent $450 to the address you gave me. I hope it helps.

You have no idea how much this means to me. I promise, as soon as I'm back on land, I'll transfer it back to you and take you out to the nicest dinner. You're the only one who's ever truly been there for me.
That means so much to hear. I just want you safe and okay. Please keep me updated.
Of course, sweetheart. I'll let you know as soon as they acknowledge the payment. I can't wait for our future together. You're my everything.
